notes.title: v1.1.0 | Spring Update 🌸
notes.content:
[h1]8 Player Lobbies[/h1]
Using a new option when creating a lobby, you can now allow up to 8 players to join your monster-feeding adventures! To do so, the host should check the "8 player lobby (experimental)" checkbox when starting a game. [b]Note: This option is experimental and may lead to unexpected bugs.[/b] Please report any issues to the discussions so we are aware. We hope you enjoy the new chaotic sessions this will cause!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890733/fdfaaf3b25fa68cbd3e5efec2064529a3baa2a70.jpg[/img]

[h1]Wendigo | New Enemy[/h1]
Something is creeping around in the biosphere outdoors... Make sure you don't mindlessly explore the darkness.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890733/80fab1987d84aec335d9c7ea9afe3317bb4b495f.jpg[/img]

[h1]Basilisk | New Enemy[/h1]
Do you hear that rattling?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890733/41ad7d5f132117d52f5b9189f568d1244a0838aa.jpg[/img]

[h1]Achievements[/h1]
Finally some recognition for all your hard work. Enjoy these 19 new achievements! Can you obtain them all?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890733/f695eb92fb9aca655424b0cb722c1984838c1190.png[/img]

[h1]Patches & Tweaks[/h1]
[list]
[*]Buffed the Failed Experiment.
[*]Reaver can now only spawn after 3 minutes have passed. Was originally anytime.
[*]Lobbies are now filtered by game version.
[*]Player volume now actually starts at 50%. It originally started at 100% even when the slider was at 50%.
[*]Player volume now saves after undocking the submarine.
[*]Fixed conditions not showing up in HUD after dying.
[*]Fixed blank enemy request from Directory Dory.
[*]Fixed Bladefist getting stuck trying to move to an invalid destination.
[*]Fixed many places where you can get stuck.
[*]Fixed enemy ladder traversal in library hub tile from castle interior.
[*]Fixed enemy pillar traversal in abyss tile from castle interior
[*]Fixed hung photos able to be sucked by Vac-Light
[*]Fixed Mimic’s animation getting desynced.
[*]Fixed Reaver’s projectile impact screen shake, causing HUD to offset too far.
[*]Fixed feast day timer sound playing when feeding the monster.
[*]Fixed water audio effect not disabling when entering the interior while submerged.
[*]Fixed Low Gravity weather affecting certain particle effects.
[*]Fixed players sometimes getting stuck in Reaver and Drone’s grasp.
[*]Fixed dying randomly when on a chair.
[*]Fixed light sometimes leaking through interior tiles.
[*]Fixed liquid flowing sound not playing for non-hosts.
[*]Fixed fishing bubbles not properly aligning to water for non-hosts.
[/list]

notes.title: v1.0.0 | Release Update 🎉
notes.content:
[h1]Perdition | New Map[/h1]
Welcome to Perdition! This variant of the lava-themed maps has you exploring the inside of a volcano. You can find this map for sale at Cory's map shop.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890733/f52a7dc2b73e4138397baefbd5e781ff1e78c984.jpg[/img]

[h1]Failed Experiment | New Enemy[/h1]
Introducing the Failed Experiment. This long-forgotten robot roams the interiors for unexpecting divers to play with. We will leave the rest for players to find out on their own.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890733/a83db7bc9a5d4f1d1d96f361b1a1a5c78a4e3bf0.jpg[/img]

[h1]Diver Mimic | New Enemy[/h1]
Unattended dead bodies may have a chance to be possessed. Be careful! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890733/55649ab148517a4a71e297b5d552ac481adb1674.png[/img]

[h1]Low Gravity | New Weather[/h1]
Reach insane heights with this new weather type.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890733/68bf201ba1723c628ff7fa6047b64573582cd4e5.png[/img]

[h1]Fishing[/h1]
No one asked, and we delivered! You can now fish in the biosphere for food items! Players must locate bubbles that spawn periodically in bodies of liquid.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890733/0b38d928d73e130e44c020e2740afa2ffc9bb7a5.jpg[/img]

[h1]Director Dory[/h1]
A new NPC has joined! Director Dory is in search of beautiful photos. Meet their requests, and you will be rewarded!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890733/36d3c833c93c44e20922e2798d101023091c25bf.png[/img]

[h1]Camera Detection System[/h1]
Cameras now detect points of interest, including Morse code, items, enemies, players, specific props, and more! If detected, the camera will print an extra description at the bottom of the photo.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890733/49e688197c1f766fc25c57f794ac697d43758106.png[/img]

[h1]Keycode Camera | New Item[/h1]
The original Keycode Camera has been renamed to just "Camera" and functions similarly but with the new detection system. A new pro-like Camera called the "Keycode Camera" will auto-translate photos of Morse code that you take! Very convenient!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890733/b8d5e8bb29ff7e6a919c0380dc0205cde7d120a8.png[/img]

[h1]Patches & Tweaks[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed bug where non-host players trying to open Item Vent would cause the swing animation and sound to repeat infinitely.
[*]Fixed bug where Phages weren’t dropping aggro.
[*]Fixed bug where Carrybot could pick up the Cartographer’s maps.
[*]Fixed bug where the infected effect visual would stay after leaving the biosphere.
[*][b]Items for sale in Rory’s Shop are now biosphere-specific.[/b]
[*]Players now have a base weight of 100lb. Note: This base weight does not affect speed.
[*]Pressure Plates are now easier, starting at 175lb and increasing by 25lb per player connected.
[*]Player dead bodies & heads now display the player’s name who died.
[*]Player dead bodies now save their skin to the save file.
[*]Made sucking items from high places a bit easier.
[*]Increased the amount of Item Vents in interiors.
[*]Decreased the amount of Painting Items in the Brimstone/Perdition interiors.
[*]Basketball Hoop plays a sound when a goal is made.
[*]Carrybot now waits longer in his guarding state every time he enters it.
[*]The door to Frostbite’s outside entrance staircase is much easier to notice.
[*]Added information to Vaclight & other items to help explain their mechanics.
[*]Added particles for when the Monster is fed & slop bucket spawn.
[*][b]Player dead bodies now have 1,000 calories if they died from anything but melee or the Monster.[/b]
[*]Wood Chairs can no longer be sat in. This change will improve load times and overall performance.
[*]Morse Clipboard Item is now easier to spot in Server Rooms.
[*]Cleaned up some interaction text.
[*]Fixed stuck spot in Cartographer Cave.
[/list]

notes.title: v0.4.5 Hotfix
notes.content:
-Added Pixelation Slider back to the options. (Default value is 0%)
[i]Developer's Note: Adding this back because we got a comment about the pixelation slider reducing lag. Internally, the pixelation slider changes a value in Unity called Render Scale. When testing, I personally never noticed improved frames by cranking pixelation to 100%, but it doesn't hurt for us to add the option back in.[/i]

notes.title: v0.4.0 | Autumn Update 🍂
notes.content:
Hey Everyone! Thank you all for continuing to play our game and leaving feedback! As we move closer to v1.0.0, we feel our game is getting closer and closer to what we originally envisioned for the full game. Speaking of which, we have some new content we'd like to share to accompany the Autumn Sale!

[h1]Brimstone | New Map[/h1]
Welcome to Brimstone! This infernal hellscape contained in a biosphere holds a secret dungeon-like interior to explore and loot! You can find this map for sale at Cory's map shop. With the inclusion of the new map, [b]Frostbite will now be free to travel to[/b].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890733/232b34f051abe0665e45b79e1ea07b80d7cbcd40.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890733/3825cf2bc8a60f34f522e64a8bf21f889f936007.jpg[/img]

[h1]Carrybot | New Enemy[/h1]
Introducing the latest robot to walk the interiors, the Carrybot! This little guy loves to store food they find in a big pile. They are passive unless they catch you taking from their stash!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890733/93feee9498bd0b3fc4a43d13778e258ea2c34d94.jpg[/img]

[h1]Item Vents[/h1]
Item Vents will now appear in the interiors. Once opened with a Crowbar, they will allow items to travel instantly to the entrance room.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890733/559236f81af465c0e9c7f5c80062787790844730.jpg[/img]

[h1]Crowbar Item[/h1]
This nifty item can be used to open Item Vents & unhook Paintings from the wall. It is sold at Rory's shop.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890733/28c949c502d004991ba75483854b0b5ad6b4ece3.png[/img]

[h1]New "Food" Items[/h1]
[h2]Painting Item[/h2]
Paintings must be unhooked by a Crowbar to grab.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890733/dfaf8eff53164987d5cf700a13ede77acae887e7.png[/img]

[h2]Uranium Item[/h2]
This dangerous item will irradiate any player who holds it. You must be swift enough to transport this item to your submarine in one piece!

[h2]Pizza Item[/h2]
Includes state-of-the-art box opening and rotating technology (yes, we took the time to develop this feature)

[h2]Turkey Item[/h2]
Just in time for the holidays!

[h1]Morse Trainer[/h1]
You can now train your Morse skills on this panel locked away in your submarine's storage room.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890733/5204f9a3f80833ce9649f3fc6a7185e1744852d1.png[/img]

[h1]Submarine Storage Room[/h1]
A new room decorated with shelves and vats to store your slop! However, one must acquire a Sledgehammer to access it.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890733/a4846935a0f6030385bd0434b4a85bcb85d75b0d.png[/img]

[h1]Pressure Plates & New Puzzle Rooms[/h1]
Pressure Plates assess your current weight. Players must stand together on the plate to reach the required weight to activate it. To accompany this feature, a new tile for each interior variant will have one of these Pressure Plates, which, once activated, will unlock a room with rewards!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890733/81fed1e665807c6b0e119347bb172fadc9b34a41.png[/img]

[h1]Drink Slop for Health[/h1]
You can now drink slop from the bucket to restore health and remove all debuffs on the player (like the "infected" effect)

[h1]"Most Feast Days Survived" Counter[/h1]
You can now track the most feast days you've survived from the main menu, pause menu and the game over screen.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890733/973c5338937d34792175ddbdd5139f71c933e6cf.png[/img]

[h1]Small Changes & Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Smoothed the feel of movement. If you have experienced a screen tearing effect when moving, this patch should help remove it.
[*]Removed pixelation effect. We feel like the game looks much better without it.
[*]Tweaked item calorie values and spawn chances.
[*]Re-balanced per-map morse puzzle translation pool.
[*]Re-balanced all map difficulties.
[*]Re-balanced Monster calorie requirement scaling.
[*]Fixed Walkie-Talkie effect getting stuck on.
[*]Fixed Audio Log dialogue box getting stuck off.
[*]Fixed being able to see through the submarine cave when spectating.
[/list]

[h1]What's Next[/h1]
Next on our priority list are more enemies and another lava-themed map.

Once again, we want to thank everyone for playing, and we hope you enjoy this new update!

notes.title: v0.3.0 | Halloween Update 🎃
notes.content:
Hey Everyone! First, we want to thank you all for playing the game and leaving helpful feedback! We very much appreciate the positive reception the game is receiving and are excited to continue developing it. To celebrate, we have put together a content update that also addresses some bugs that have been reported.

[h1]Emotes[/h1]
First off, emotes! Players can play emotes using the 1-4 keys (by default). Currently, in order, we have a wave, point, clap, and dance emote to try out with your friends!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890733/d73d940e6bf29d7b4549c07aea866697ddd9f2bb.gif[/img]

[h1]Enemy Logs[/h1]
We now have logs for every enemy that helps explain their mechanics and give some background on what they are. You can obtain these logs by encountering an enemy and returning to your submarine to play it from the Audio Log Computer. Selecting a log from the computer will play it for everyone in the submarine.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890733/a024facc63caf2828c7b3bb7b6b4fe0bc972c5d4.png[/img]

[h1]The Gramophone & Records[/h1]
Want to scavenge the biospheres and interiors with style? Introducing the Gramophone. Available for purchase from Rummager Rory, the Gramophone is an elegant way to play music for all to hear! Want more songs? Explore the outdoor biosphere to find hidden records and feed them to the entity to unlock them!

[i]All songs are made in-house, by our friend CaptainKray. If you have followed us for a while, you may find some of these tracks familiar.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890733/52ed0b1fd345bcdef2d603b423cb2ae10d712105.png[/img]

[h1]Change Suits[/h1]
Players can now change their suit color by interacting with a bed. The color of the bed is the color of the suit you will change into. Don't tell anyone, but a secret Halloween skin is hidden somewhere in the game. Good luck finding it!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890733/c8c5e0ef88425b31bf9ee2b5637c81673a36c4ef.gif[/img]

[h1]Pumpkin Item[/h1]
The Pumpkin is a hefty but rewarding festive item to find in the biosphere interiors.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890733/1a0845a2d6e3ce8baca53f1deef2a62c938befbd.png[/img]

[h1]Hang Photos[/h1]
You can now hang photos on most walls by pressing F (by default). Also, picking up photos will now merge with any held photo stack.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890733/fd0d939b29e4b1eca441f9d6488e1379870c0685.png[/img]

[h1]Stinky Items[/h1]
Items have a very low chance of being "stinky." Stinky items have an increased calorie value.

[h1]New Secret Room[/h1]
There's one new secret room for each interior style.

[h1]Interior Door Warning[/h1]
The doors leading to the outside biosphere will now warn players if a tornado is nearby on the other side.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890733/59e1d7d74fe4861013a42a5984c1c1f73ab61d3b.png[/img]

[h1]Spectate UI Improvements[/h1]
When spectating, you can now see what players are dead with you and the name of the player you are currently spectating.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890733/1a990d205e29df3c338a04878091163b5fba14ea.png[/img]

[h1]Health & Item Calorie Value on HUD[/h1]
When appropriate, your health value and the calorie value for the currently held item will now appear on the HUD.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890733/28ba72cdecd92b8315039f4309416c734f64a04d.png[/img]

[h1]Vac-Pack scaling[/h1]
Your Vac-Pack (backpack) model will now scale in size based on the number of items in your Vac-Light.

[h1]Game Difficulty Decreased[/h1]
We have made some changes to enemy speed, enemy spawning, and calorie requirements to help make the game feel more fair. We also reduced the frequency of droids camping at the biosphere entrance and added a room in the center of the staircase for players to hide from droids. For Slimeworks, we have removed many thorn bushes and decreased their damage from 10 to 5.

[h1]Small Changes & Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] There is now a single Vac-Light that spawns in the sub.
[*] The Podophage (Purple virus-looking enemy) will no longer hurt players who are not latched by it.
[*] Fixed Infected effect not getting removed when leaving biosphere.
[*] Photos are now saved with your save file. (Previously, the photo would just be blank upon loading an old save)
[*] Saves will no longer become laggy the further you play.
[*] Saves from older versions can now be played with newer versions (versions that change how saving is handled will still be prevented from loading)
[*] Fixed many places where players can get stuck.
[*] Fixed being unable to interact with the exit hatch on the top of the ladder.
[*] Fixed being able to suck items through doors.
[*] You can no longer collide with other players near interior entrances and exit hatches. This should prevent launching other players when they both enter/leave the interior simultaneously.
[/list]

[h1]Free Demo Returning for Steam Scream Fest[/h1]
The free demo offers a slice of the full game and will remain available during the week of Steam Scream Fest. [b]Multiplayer between the free demo and the full game is not cross-compatible.[/b]

[h1]What's Next[/h1]
Next on our priority list are more enemies and more maps. We are also aware of a bug that causes voice chat to randomly stop working for some players. At the moment, the only way to fix this is by saving (only possible while undocked/at-sea), leaving, and having everyone re-join. This is a nasty issue that we have been looking into for a while and we will continue to do so.

Thanks for playing everyone, and we hope you enjoy this new update!

notes.title: v0.1 - Major Demo Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone! As we approach the release of the full game, we wanted to put out what will likely be our last [b]major[/b] demo update. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890733/0bf67284801bcbda41549732aeb64595f34c0edd.gif[/img]


[h2]What you'll find[/h2]
- 2 new maps
- 2 new interior facility layouts
- 3 new enemies
- 3 new pieces of equipment, purchasable from the shop. 
- New hazards within the facilities.
- Save files
- Server browser

and many QOL changes based on feedback from the last version of the demo.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890733/0f74737d078ab7e448513e3a1fbc3f1afcf022f1.gif[/img]

We've also restarted the version numbering, with this update being v0.1, and v1.0 coming soon for the full game.

We loved getting to see you all play our first version of the demo back during Summer Next Fest, and we hope you have lots of fun with this new update.
